I have been a patient at LifeStance for about a year now and have only positive things to say about the care I have received.

At LifeStance supported practices, there’s no one-size-fits-all approach to mental health. We tailor our care plans to fit each person’s unique needs. Our supported clinicians include psychiatrists, psychologists, and licensed therapists who are ready to support you. LifeStance supported practices offer both in-person and telehealth appointments , so you get the care you need in the format that serves you best. We also accept major insurance plans , allowing you to get the most from your personalized care plan.
Get help for your specific condition
Find the right clinician match for you
Book an in-person or online appointment
Our supported clinicians help people living with a variety of mental health conditions.
Depression, bipolar disorders, or seasonal affective disorder can affect a person’s mood in a way that negatively impacts your life. Learning more about these mood disorders can help.
Generalized anxiety disorder is a mental health condition characterized by a chronic and sustained worry that is intense enough to interrupt daily life.
These conditions often require specialized care. We can help people cope with conditions such as avoidant, borderline, and obsessive-compulsive personality disorders.
Conditions like ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and oppositional defiant disorder can impact many parts of a person’s mental health. Learn how professionals can help.
Our expansive network of licensed clinicians offers a wide variety of services.
We provide mental health services when and where you need it.

Empowering Patient Care with LifeStance Health Support

Every day, healthcare professionals see patients needing mental health treatment. As a trusted member of their care team, they look to you to provide guidance on their path to well-being. LifeStance Health’s clinicians treat a broad range of conditions and are in-network with more than 240 insurance plans. In most states, patients can be scheduled for therapy and/or psychiatry services in less than one week.

Why Refer Your Patient to LifeStance Health

As a healthcare provider, you want nothing but the best for your patients. When your patient receives care at LifeStance, you can be sure they are receiving the compassionate, specialized care they deserve. LifeStance Health employs psychiatrists, psychologists, psychiatric nurse practitioners, and licensed therapists who practice as a unified care team to create personalized treatment plans and ensure continuity of care.

LifeStance Health offers both in-person and online therapy and psychiatry appointments. Our hybrid model allows patients to overcome traditional barriers to receiving care. We meet your patients where it’s most convenient for them.

Behavioral health integration supports whole person care, and LifeStance makes that integration efficient and accessible. With LifeStance, providers can partner with a structured behavioral health system that reduces fragmentation and ensures consistent, high-quality care for patients of all ages and stages. Together, we can improve patient outcomes faster, reduce overall health care costs and streamline operations, allowing you to focus on what you do best—providing exceptional care.
Dr. Ujjwal Ramtekkar Chief Medical Officer at LifeStance Health
Stay Involved in the Care Your Patient Receives

When you refer someone to LifeStance Health, you gain a collaborative team. We are your partners in caring for your patients. We keep you informed of your patient’s treatment plan so you can take their mental health needs into account as part of your overall treatment plan.
LifeStance clinicians can treat patients across all age groups, from pediatric to geriatric. With a diverse team of expert clinicians, LifeStance Health can help patients across all demographics.
The specialized clinicians at LifeStance Health treat patients with a wide variety of mental health conditions, including:
Inquire About Partnering to Refer Your Patients to LifeStance

Thank you for your interest in partnering with LifeStance Health! If you would like to refer your patients to LifeStance Health or have another partnership inquiry, please complete this form for more information.

LifeStance’s Care Access Pathway is a dedicated referral solution developed in partnership with health systems, provider groups, and enterprise partners to streamline access to high-quality outpatient behavioral health care. For more information on Care Access Pathway, submit an inquiry request here .
Please note: We cannot accommodate preceptorships or internships at this time.

LifeStance’s Care Access Pathway is a dedicated referral solution developed in partnership with health systems, provider groups, and enterprise partners to streamline access to high-quality outpatient behavioral health care.

Designed in collaboration with our trusted CAP partners, this streamlined process guides individuals through every step—from initial outreach to continuing care—using best-in-class referral pathways and personalized support. CAP is built to reduce administrative burden, close the care loop, and strengthen continuity of care — while empowering partners with meaningful data to support population health goals. Most importantly, CAP ensures that patients are quickly and compassionately connected to the care they need, when they need it most.
To request more information on LifeStance’s Care Access Pathway, please complete this form.
LifeStance Health accepts more than 240 insurance plans. Visit your state’s insurance page to see if we accept your insurance.
Yes, please complete our partnership inquiry web form, and someone will respond to you.
LifeStance has immediate availability in most states, and most patients can be scheduled in less than 1 week for therapy and psychiatry services.
Yes, LifeStance works with primary care and women’s health practices to integrate a behavioral health specialist as part of medical care teams.
Yes, LifeStance offers in-person care at more than 550 locations in 35 states, as well as telehealth in each of those states.
